div.head: prathamō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
śrīvardhamānamānamya chandasāṁ pūrvamakṣaram ।
lakṣyalakṣaṇamāvīkṣya vakṣyē chandō’nuśāsanam

chandaḥśāstraṁ vahitraṁ tadvivikṣōḥ kāvyasāgaram ।
chandōbhāg vāṅmayaṁ sarvaṁ na kiṁcicchandasā vinā

nāgarañcakāravakrō gururdvimātrō gasaṁjñakō jñēyaḥ ।
laghurēkamātrikaḥ syādr̥jururdhvāṅgulanibhō lasaṁjñaśca

dīrghō guruḥ plutō’pi hrasvō laghurēva vā guruḥ pādāntē ।
saṁyōgavisargānusvāravyañjanaparō guruḥ syād hrasvaḥ

saṁyōgaparō’pi jātu varṇaḥ
śaithilyāllaghutāmupaiti tasmāt ।
bhāṣāviṣayē’nyathā jagaddhā
ṣyēdaudau tu gurū laghū ca dr̥ṣṭau

mayarasatajabhanavarṇā bhūtōyānalamarunnabhō’rkēndudivaḥ ।
vr̥ttagaṇāḥ kramaśō’ṣṭau prastārē viddhi madhyamacchandasi tān

gurōradhastāllaghumāditaḥ kṣipēt
paraṁ likhēddūrdhvasamaṁ punastathā ।
pāścātyakhaṇḍaṁ guruṇā prapūrayēt
yāvadgaṇaḥ sarvalaghutvamāpyatē

sarvagururmagaṇaḥ kṣitirādilaghuryaḥ payōgaṇō jñēyaḥ ।
madhyalaghū rō’gniḥ syādantaguruḥ sō marunnāmā

antarlaghustagaṇaḥ khaṁ madhyagururjagaṇa ucyatē sūryaḥ ।
ādigururbhaścandraḥ sarvasvanaḥ svastrikāḥ sarvē’pi

vāgvirāmō yatiḥ syātsaṁsyāpyatē śrutisundaram ।
pādāntē sūcitasthānē yuktapādāntē viśēṣataḥ
div.note: Obvious mistakes of the scribe are corrected; the Avagraha is regularly marked though the scribe does not do so. The same is true of Sandhis.
div.ab:
sandhikāraḥ samabhara ityēkō’rthastathēṣṭyatē’tra virāmaḥ ।
luptavibhaktirūpadamiti samāsapadamurucyatē yathā tatra yatiḥ

sañcāriṇāyyaghakulaharāṇyarhatō’nyatra na syuḥ
tatraivāptapravacanapadārthāṁśca yuktyā ghaṭantē ।
tasmāttanniścitamiti vinēyāḥ śrayantyātmavantō
yatyuktōdāharaṇamidamityādirasti prayōgaḥ

vāñchanti yatiṁ piṅgalavasiṣṭhakauṇḍinyakapilakambalamunayaḥ ।
nēcchanti bharatakōhalamāṇḍavyāśvatarasaitavādyāḥ kēcit

pr̥thagvidhānādracanāviśēṣaḥ
phalaṁ kavērlakṣaṇamādyamēva ।
prāgadyatarnīma ca nānyathātra
lōkaprasiddhau na kr̥tō vivādaḥ

uktamēkākṣaraṁ chandō’tyuktaṁ taddvyakṣaraṁ tathā ।
madhyamaṁ tryakṣaraṁ chandaḥ pratiṣṭhā caturakṣarī

supratiṣṭhā pañcākṣarī gāyatrī tu ṣaḍakṣarī ।
uṣṇik saptākṣarī jñēyānuṣṭubaṣṭākṣarī tataḥ

br̥hatī navākṣarī syātpaṅktirastu daśākṣarī tatastriṣṭup ।
ēkādaśākṣarītyapi śēṣāścaikaikavr̥ddhyā syuḥ

jagatī tathātijagatī śakkaryatiśakkarī tataścāṣṭiḥ ।
atyaṣṭiriṣṭiratidhr̥tirataḥ kr̥tiḥ prakr̥tikarākr̥tirvikr̥tiśca

saṁkr̥tirabhikr̥tirutkr̥tiriti ṣaḍviṁśatiranukramācchandāṁsi ।
vr̥ttānīha bhavanti hi ṣaḍviṁśati tatparaṁ tu mālāvr̥ttam

vr̥ttaṁ jātiriti dvēdhā padyaṁ tacca catuṣpadī ।
gaṇabaddhaṁ tathā vr̥ttaṁ jātirmātrāgaṇāśritā

vr̥ttaṁ samamardhasamaṁ viṣamaṁ mālāvkhyamiti caturdhā; jātiḥ ।
āryā mātrāsamakaṁ vaitālīya dvipadyapīti caturdhau

saṁskr̥tavācyāryādyāḥ prākr̥taviṣayē tu galitakādyā bahudhā ।
karṇāṭakē’kṣarādyā viṣayē ‡ śīrṣakādijātaya uditāḥ
div.note: One long or two short letters are missing.
div.ab:
khaṇḍakāścaṇḍavr̥ṣṭādyāḥ pādāṁśaniyamōditāḥ ।
apādāniyamāśrōktā gaṇadhā gadyadaṇḍakāḥ

svacchandaḥsaṁjñā raghaṭā mātrākṣarasamōditāḥ ।
pādadvandvasamākīrṇā suśravyā saiva paddhatiḥ

pādā(r. dō’)kṣaramātrāniyamōditapiṇḍō’tha pādavatpadyaṁ syāt ।
pādadvitīyavarṇaḥ pādaṁ pādaṁ ya ēti sō’nuprāsaḥ

gadyaṁ hr̥dyamapādōktissamāsapadasaṁcitam ।
tatō’nyaccūrṇirityuktā vacanaṁ vākyabandhuram

samamēkēna dvābhyāmardhasamaṁ dr̥śyatē caturbhiḥ pādaiḥ ।
viṣamaṁ jātiśca tathā prastārapratyayē yathā tadvyāptiḥ

ēkadvitryādisaṁkhyārthaṁ candranētrapurādikam ।
chandō’rthaṁ gr̥hyatē lōkānnāprayuktaṁ prayujyatē

div.head: tr̥tīyō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
athātō’rdhasamaṁ vakṣyē yatprayōgānusāri tat ।
tadakṣarasamaṁ hīnamadhikaṁ cēti dr̥śyatē

upacitrakamardhasamēṣvidaṁ
sau salagā yadi bhau bhagurū gaḥ

yatra rukbhāra( ? )gaṇatritayādgau
najajayamapyanu sā drutamadhyā

saha satritayēna guruścēt
bhatritayēna ca vēgavatī gau

tāñjau⟨?⟩ guruṇātha mātsajau gau
bhadrairbhadravirāṭ svabhāṇi vr̥ttam

sajasā bhavanti guruṇātha
kētumatī bharau yadi nagau gaḥ

ākhyānakī tau jagaṇēna gau cēt
tathā jatau jēna gurudvayāntau

jatau jagau gastatajā gurū cē
dākhyānakī syādviparītapūrvā

rājjagau jarau lagau
yadā tadā pravartakam

lagapāra-sakāragaṇaistribhi
rnabhabharaistu gaṇairhariṇīplutā

yadi nanaralagā najau jarau
tadaparavaktramakāri sūribhiḥ

nagaṇayugarayēṇa puṣpitāgrā
najajaragairviditā jinavratāṁśaiḥ

sābhidhā yavadhvanērmatō ( r. tup ) striyāṁ hi
rajau rajau punarjarau jarau ca gaścēt

syādiha māninī diśi yatirbharanabhanalagāḥ ॥
najabhajanā gaṇāḥ sasahitā yadi haraviratiḥ

sasajā gurusaṁyutāstataḥ
sabharā lgau ca vibōdhitā bhavēt

sasajā guruyugmasaṁyutāḥ syuḥ
sabharā yaśca subōdhitā priyā vā

bhāti narāṁ bhagaṇābhyāṁ talagai
rnajanasagairapi vilasitalīlā

puramitanagaṇayamatha mau gaḥ ।
kṣāntiḥ prōktā cūḍēyam

viṣadharaviramaṇamudadhinagaṇasā
yatiyatirurugī nanabhanalaghugā

āmalakī bhacatuṣṭayamatra tu ।
bhatrayagā giti saiva ca cukṣā

jatau jarau śaṁkhanidhistu tau jarau ।
śrīpālyakīrtīśamatē sunandinī

tau ñrau⟨?⟩ tathā padmanidhirjatau jarau ।
svayambhudēvēśamatē tu nandinī

bhāmā bhavēdbhuvi gatibhāgvirāmā ।
tabhau yadā sayamatha jādbhasau yaḥ

tathōditā yatiriha jādbhasau yaḥ ।
tādbhaḥ sayāvapi viparītabhāmā

cūḍāmaṇistadvayajā gurū cēt ।
prajñāmahōdayamatā tabhajā jagau gaḥ

salilanidhiguṇitadharaṇidharalaghuradhigatagururayamasamacaraṇaḥ ।
taditara iti guruparaśikhivihitalaghudaśatayayutiraghaṭi sa khaluśikhā

vyatihr̥tapariśatayamayamabhavanikhilacaraṇasamupajanitapadaracanā ।
iyamiti bhavati hi bhuvi parikuṭilacalananigadanasadr̥śasamabhidhā*

div.head: caturthō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
athātō viṣamaṁ vakṣyē yatprayōgānusāri tat ।
tat tridhā lakṣaṇē dr̥ṣṭaṁ samānōnādhikākṣaram

caturakṣaratō yaścēnnō cēdādyakṣarātsnau tu ।
vaktravadviṣamāṇaṁ tadvaktramānuṣṭubhaṁ bhāti

ōjayōryagaṇēnābdhēryugmayōrjagaṇēna ca ।
ślōkēṣu kathyatē pathyā śrōtrapathyā yatastataḥ

jagaṇō’bdhēryadaujayōryagaṇō yugmayōścēttham ।
viparītōktalakṣaṇādviparītādi pathyā syāt

abdhērayugmacaraṇē naścēdyugmē yakāraścēt ।
yasyāṁ sāpi tu capalānuṣṭubmadhyē bhavatyēvam

vaktravadviṣamaḥ pādaḥ samē laghuścētsaptamē ।
anuṣṭubvipulāstvēvaṁ piṅgalācāryavipulā

śrutikāntaṁ laghau sati pratipādaṁ tu saptamē ।
sutarāmatra vibudhairmatā saitavavipulā

bhavēdyadābdhēḥ paratō bhakāraḥ sarvatra tadā ।
bhakārasaṁjñāṁ vipulāṁ bhaṇantyanuṣṭubnipuṇāḥ

paratō’bdhēryatra rēphē paritaḥ pādēṣu dr̥ṣṭē ।
vipulānāṁ rēphasaṁjñā vipulā bhavēttadānīm

nakārō’bdhēryadi bhavēdviṣamāṁhrau yuji tathā ।
sphuṭaṁ nakāravipulā vipulājñairiti matā

sarvataścaturbhyaḥ parō yadyasau takārō bhavēt ।
vipulāsu jātiṣvatastakārasaṁjñāṁ tāṁ viduḥ

yakārō’bdhērayukpādē yadi kaścidyuji gaṇaḥ ।
kaścidōjē jō yujyēvaṁ saṁkīrṇavipulā dvidhā
div.note: The ms. adds the words khaṁjā nāma hereafter.
div.ab:
yau prathamē hi vaktrādau nādyātsnāviti vāritau ।
tau kvacidapi dr̥śyētē lakṣyēṣu śrutisundaram

dvātriṁśadakṣarō granthaḥ sōnuṣṭup ślōka ityapi ।
ślōkastu gadyatē padyaṁ puṇyaślōkairmanīṣibhiḥ

prōktamanuṣṭubhi vaktraṁ pathyā viparītapathyayā capalā ।
piṅgalasaitavavipulā bharanatavipulāśca saṁkīrṇāḥ

prathamō’yamaṣṭavarṇō ।
dvādaśavarṇō dvitīyakaḥ pādaḥ syāt ।
ṣōḍaśavarṇō’tha tr̥tīyō viṁśatyakṣarasturyō ।
yasya tadētatpadacaturūrdhvaṁ nānāgati trayōdaśadhā

tadanu saha tathā yā ।
bhavati yatibhr̥diyamiti pīḍā ।
dviguruparakalaghumayacaraṇacatuṣkā ।
kvacidaghaṭi padaruciriha lipimitirajani taccēt

pratyādiriyamapi ca ।
pīḍā praticaraṇamubhayaguru ॥
pūrvatra bhavati samuparigalaghuvisr̥ti ।
sā kvāpyanupadarucirucitalipiparimitiriti ca

pādākṣaramitirasyāḥ ।
prāgvad bhavati samupapadapīḍā ॥
ādyantaguruyugasakalalaghucaraṇāsau ।
kvāpyēvamatipadaruciratiruciramr̥dupadavr̥ttiḥ

prathamaśakala iha viparītau ।
yadi padarucipādau ॥
caraṇayugamaparamapi bhavati yathāsvaṁ ।
praticaraṇakalitayatirati padarucikalikāsau

bhūyō’pi sadanupadarucikali
kākhyēyamiti bhavati ॥
paurastyacaraṇayugamiha khalu vicalati ।
pāścātyacaraṇayugamacalitamatiśayitamaghaṭi

ādau vyatihr̥tamatipadarucyāḥ ।
pādau yadi viparītau ॥
pādadvitayamitaradiha bhavati yathāsvaṁ ।
syādityapi surucirayatiratipadarucikalikākhyā

apasarati padarucivilagnaṁ ।
kramayugalamatha na khalu calati caturtham ॥
prathama iha tr̥tīyō ।
yadi bhavati vikr̥tagatiriti padarucilavalī syāt

syādēvamanupadarucilavali
kākhyā praticaraṇaniyatagurulaghurapi ॥
pādanyasanamiha tu ।
tadvatsamanubhavati jagati sunicitapadavisr̥ti

madhyāṁhriyugalamatipadarucyāḥ ।
pūrvaṁ bhavati; caramacaraṇa iha yathāsvam ॥
ādyaṁhriratha tr̥tīyaḥ ।
padyēṣviyamapi ca sayatiratipadarucilavalī syāt

yadi bhavati gaditapadarucyāḥ ।
prathamataracaraṇa iha sa khalu caturthaḥ ॥
tricaraṇamupasarati ca padaruciyugamr̥tadhārā ।
jitasadamr̥tadhārā

ādyaṁhriranupadarucivadiha ।
turyō yadi bhavati niyatagurulaghutati ॥
anyatra caraṇamaghaṭi tadanupadaruciyugamr̥ta- ।
dhārēyamiti bhavati

pādaḥ prathama iha yadi turīyaḥ ।
pādatrayamanusarati tadatipadarucyāḥ ॥
pādairasamagatibhiratipadaruciyugamamr̥tadhārā ।
pādatrakavibhiruktā

padacaturūrdhvā pīḍā pratyāpīḍā ca bhavati saṁpīḍā ॥
kalikā lavalī cāmr̥tadhārā tisraḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak tridhāstāḥ

ōjapādē’nuṣṭubhō yēya ( 9 ) mā jagatyā vivardhitā ∥ 8 ∥
sā vijātigāthā jambukakathā (11) paśyatyādivaducyatē (8)

anuṣṭub viṣamākhyānāṁ ṣaḍbhiḥ pādairyathōditaiḥ ।
jātigāthā bhavatyēvamēnāṁ tu cchāndasīṁ viduḥ ॥
' daśa dharmaṁ na jānantī ' tyādērādiprayōgataḥ

yathā— daśa dharmaṁ na jānanti dhr̥tarāṣṭra nibōdha tān ।
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaḥ śrāntaḥ kruddhō bubhukṣitaḥ ।
tvaramāṇaśca bhīruśca lubdhaḥ kāmī tvamī daśa

iyaṁ ṣaṭpadagāthā ।
sajasā laghuḥ prathamakē’tha ।
nasajagurukā dvitīyakē ॥
bhanau ca jalagiti tr̥tīyatarē ।
yadi turyakē sajasajāgihōdgatā

prathamadvitīyakaturīya— ।
caraṇaniyamō’tra pūrvavat ॥
syāttr̥tīyacaraṇē ranabhaṁ ।
guruṇēti saurabhakamudgatōdgatam

nagaṇadvayaṁ sayugalaṁ ca ।
yadi padi tr̥tīyakē tathā ॥
viṣamamapi lalitamityabhavat ।
mr̥dupādalālitatayōdgatādikē

atha ( +tat ? )tr̥tīyacaraṇē tu ।
nabhajalaghugaṁ pravartatē ॥
jagati kīrtiranuvartigatiḥ ।
kavicārukīrtimuninā prakīrtitā

nsau jbhau gau prathamē; dvitīyakē sanajā gauṁ ।
dvinasaṁ tadanu tr̥tīyakē, caturthē ॥
triguṇitanagaṇajayāḥ ।
pracupitamidamuditamupasthitapūrvam

yasyaitasya tr̥tīyapādakē dvinasaṁ dviḥ ।
nitarāṁ tadiha vividdhi vardhamānam ॥
pracupitaniyamasamānamitaradapi sakalaṁ ।
samuditamr̥dupadapadavīkamitīdam

yadyēvaṁ tajarāstr̥tīyakē pādē tasya ।
prathamē yatirapi cārṣabhaṁ purastāt ॥
syācchuddhavirāḍidaṁ yadi ।
pracupitaniyamaniyamitāparalakṣmā

jātivijātī gāthā tathōdgatā saurabhakasulalitē kīrtiḥ ।
bhavatītyupasthitapracupitakamatō vardhamānamapi śuddhavirāṭ

div.head: pañcamō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
dvigurustathāntagururādiguruśca caturlaghuśca madhyaguruḥ ।
iti pañcāryādigaṇāḥ prastārē’tra nu gurōradhō laghukau dvau

sapta caturmātragaṇā guruṇāryārddhadvayē na cāyuji jaḥ ।
jaḥ ṣaṣṭhō nlagaṇō vā laghuraparē trigaṇaviṣamāṁhniḥ

pādau prathamatr̥tīyau dvādaśamātrau dvitīya āryāyāḥ ।
aṣṭādaśamātrō’sau caturthakaḥ pañcadaśamātraḥ

āryaujapādanidhanē yatyāṁ pathyōbhayatra, pūrvārdhē ।
yatyāṁ tu pūrvapathyā parārdhayatyāṁ ca parapathyā

vipulā syādāryāviṣamapādayuganidhanayatyatikramaṇāt ।
nlagaṇaṁ pratyāryādivirāmaniyāmaṁ pravakṣyāmaḥ

nlē pañcamē caturthagaṇāntē padamiha hi vasati tadanu tathā ।
ṣaṣṭhē ṣaṣṭhagaṇādau saptamakē nlē ca ṣaṣṭhāntē

gurumadhyagau bhavantau gaṇau jakārau dvitīyakacaturthau ।
syātāṁ tathā yadāryādaladvayē sarvacapalā syāt

jagaṇau dvitīyaturyau tathōditāvubhayapārśvaguruyuktau ।
pūrvārdhē yasyāḥ sā mukhacapalā śēṣamāryāvat

pūrvārdhamihāryāvat paścārdhē pūrvaparaguruśliṣṭau ।
dr̥ṣṭau dvitīyaturyau yadā tu jau jaghanacapalā syāt

gurvantasaptagaṇabhāgāryāpūrvārdhalakṣaṇaṁ sakalam ।
yadyubhayārdhē yasyāḥ pravartatē sā nu gītiriti gītā

yō’yamiha ṣaṣṭhalaghubhāgāryāparadalagatō niyamaḥ ।
sakalaḥ śakalayugē cēdyasyāstāmāhurupagītim

ṣaṣṭhalaghubhāgyādāryāparadalaniyamō’tra pūrvārdhē ।
guruparasaptagaṇāryāprāgvanniyamaḥ parē yadōdgītiḥ

sarvacaturmātragaṇō gurvantāṣṭamagaṇōbhayārdhaḥ skandhaḥ ।
pūrvatrigaṇaujāṁhriḥ sarvatrāyuji na jō; nlajau vā ṣaṣṭhaḥ

sarvalaghuḥ skandhō’sau gurvantāṣṭamagaṇatvatō nāsti bhr̥śam ।
sarvagururnāsti tathā pūrvamatānniyataṣaṣṭhajanlagaṇatvāt

triṁśaddvāścatvārō lāstē skandhasya varṇakā nyūnāścēt ।
vardhantē cēddvābhyāṁ lāḥ ṣaṣṭistatkalāścatuḥṣaṣṭiḥ syuḥ

sphurati sa tu niyataguruparapurahatalaghudaśakaghaṭitasayaśakalayugaḥ ।
surucirayatiyutamr̥dupadaviracitagaticaraṇavisr̥tiriti budhayāditaḥ⟨?⟩

āryāgītērardhēnāryārdhaṁ kiṁcanapi kathamapi saha cēt ।
āryāvidaiḥ praṇītētyāryaiḥ saṁkīrṇajātiriyam

skandhasya ṣaṣṭhadhāmanyabhitaścaikō l yadōpaskandhaḥ ।
utskandhaḥ paurastyē pāścātyārdhē tadāvaskandhaḥ

gītistu ripucchandaḥ saptamaragaṇē tr̥tīyakē lalitā ।
tadubhayari bhadrikā syātṣaṣṭhaṁ tu vimucya rabahulā vicitrā

sugatacaturgatimātragaṇāṁhri pragaṇitamalāntagaṇanidhanadalam ।
nagaṇavikalpitajagaṇaturyapadaṁ jagaṇēna naujadhāma dhruvakam

tadīyaviṣamāspadē’pi yadā jagaṇō’tha ṣaṣṭhō’nyathā tathā vā ।
tadā tathā skandhakē’pidū+ripucchandaādi virūḍhasaṁjñām

gāthāryādidalādāryāṁśayugē pūrvavatparārdhē tadgaṇayugavr̥dhdyā ।
udvyavasamupādhiparā mālāgāthā tatō’pyadhikā

āryā pathyātritayaṁ vipulā capalātrayaṁ tathā gītiḥ ।
upagītiścōdgītiścāryāgītirapi saiva ca skandhaḥ

saṁkīrṇacatuṣkamupaskandhaścōtskandha ityavaskandhaḥ ।
gatibhēdaripucchandō dhruvakamatastatra saptavidhagāthāśca

praticaraṇakayatiyugacaladhr̥tiratha ।
gatihatagatilaghuratimr̥dugatiriti ॥
samamapi samamiti na tu bhuvi samaghaṭi ।
samajani pr̥thagiha lasamakasamitiṣu

mātrāsamakēṣu vadanti catu—
rmātrōktacaturgaṇamāryajanāḥ ।
mātrāsamakaṁ gaparāṁśāntaṁ
mātrā navamīha tu laghvī syāt

bhagaṇō bhavati tr̥tīyagaṇōtrā
muktaḥ pūrvavadēva sunētrā ।
vadi pūrgaṇa(?) muninētyupacitrā ।
sōktāṁhrāviti ṣōḍaśamātrā

catasr̥bhya ēva mātrābhyō jō ।
nlau vānyadiha tathā viślōkaḥ ॥
kāvyaṁ hi tēna puṇyaślōkāḥ ।
prajñāmahōdayāḥ kathayanti

mātrābhyō’ṣṭābhya ēva yasyā ।
jō nlau vā pūrvavadiha śēṣam ॥
saviśēṣādvānavāsikēti ।
pravadanti viśēṣavādinastām

mātrābhya imau catasr̥bhyaḥ sau ।
yatrābhihitāvitaratprāgvat ॥
mātrāsamajātiṣu sā kathitā ।
citrāṁśavirāmavicitratayā

kaiścinmātrāsamakādīnāṁ ।
pādairmiśrairdvitricaturṇām ॥
pādākulakaṁ kavipādaistad ।
vyāpāditaṁ catuṣpadyēvam

apratipāditapādairgantaiḥ ।
pratipāditapādairapi sārdham ॥
prōktaṁ piṅgalapādākulakaṁ ।
tilakaṁ sucatuṣṣaṣṭikalānām

yasyāḥ pūrvārdhē’ṣṭau dīrghā dviḥ syuḥ syāt sānaṅgakrīḍā ।
tadaparaśakalaka iha jalanidhihatasaduditavasuparimitasulaghava iti

guruparanidhiyutakr̥timitalaghusuruciradalayugayugatirucirā ।
gurutarakavijanaviracitakr̥tiṣu ca varapadagatiriyamavagatā

mātrāsamakācaladhr̥tyupacitrāvānavāsikāviślōkāḥ ।
citrāpādākulakānaṅgakrīḍāhvayātirucirā gaditāḥ

acaladhr̥tirgītyāryānaṅgakrīḍā śikhā bhavēnnāmnā ।
atirucirā tatra tu cūlikā matā piṅga (+la ) sya matē

acaladhr̥tiḥ samavr̥ttaṁ syādatirucirārdhasamamanaṅgakrīḍā ।
viṣamamiha tatkimityabhyadhāyi kavibhiḥ kalāsamakē

div.head: ṣaṣṭhō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
vaitālīyādīnāṁ ṣaṇmātragaṇō’ṣṭadhāṣṭalaḥ ṣōḍaśadhā ।
tricaturgurutaḥ prastārō’trāpi gurōradhō laghū dvau dvau staḥ

viṣamē padi ṣaṭ samē’ṣṭa vai ।
vaitālīyakalā ralagparāḥ ।
asamātra laghusthiti naṁ cēt ।
laghavaḥ ṣaṇna nirantarāḥ samē

mātrāniyamō’tra pūrvavatsyāt ।
aupacchandasikaṁ tathā rayāntam ।
mātrāgaṇalakṣaṇadvayēna ।
vyāpādyanta imē vicitrapādāḥ

sūtravidōktaṁ pratipādaṁ ।
yatra parau bhagaṇēna gakārau ।
sātra matāpātalikā syu
rmātrā vaitālīyavadasyāḥ

vaitālīyasamāṁhrilakṣaṇaṁ ।
pratipādaṁ khalu yatra vartatē ।
tatsamavaitālīyanāmakaṁ ।
saṁdr̥śyaṁ chandō’nuśāsanē

viṣamāṁhrigataṁ yadatra tad ।
vaitālīyasya lakṣaṇam ।
paritō viṣamābhidhānabhr̥d ।
vaitālīyaṁ taducyatē

aupacchandasikasya lakṣaṇaṁ yat ।
samapādōditamatra vartatē cēt ।
pratipādaṁ tannāma tatsamaupa
cchandasikaṁ chandōvidaiḥ⟨?⟩ praṇītam

ōjāṁhrigataṁ tathā yadaupa
cchandasikākhyasya lakṣaṇaṁ cēt ।
abhitō viṣamābhidhānakaupa
cchandasikaṁ chandasīha dr̥ṣṭam

āpātalikājātisamāṁhri
praṇiyatalakṣaṇamaṣṭakalādyam ।
yatra yadā bhagurudvitayāntaṁ ।
pratyaṁhri samāpātalikā sā

āpātalikāviṣamāṁhri
praṇihitalakṣmaṇyabhitō’smin ।
ṣaṇmātrādyādi⟨?⟩[ + ga ]yugmē ।
sati viṣamāpātalikā syāt

samayōryadi pādayōrgurau ।
turyapañcamakalāsamāgamē ॥
vaitālīyōktayōryadā ।
prācyavr̥ttiriti nāma vartatē

udīcyavr̥ttirbhavēdyadā ।
vaitālīyagataujapādayōḥ ।
gurau satīha prayuktayō
rdvaitīyīkatr̥tīyamātrayōḥ

udīcyavr̥ttyōjalakṣaṇaṁ ।
prācyavr̥ttisamapādalakṣaṇam ।
yathāsvamatrēti cētsmr̥taṁ ।
vr̥ttajātinipuṇaiḥ pravartakam

yatpravartakasamāṁhrilakṣaṇaṁ ।
lakṣyatēṁhriṣu caturṣu kēvalam ।
lalitajātiṣu niśātabuddhaya
stāmuśanti bahudhāparāntikam

pravartakaujāṁhrilakṣaṇaṁ ।
pravartatē cēnnirantaram ।
pravartakaiśchandasāmasau ।
pravartitā cāruhāsinī

yadi caupacchandasākhyajātau ।
prācyavr̥ttiniyamō bhavēdyathāsvam ।
viditaupacchandasābhidhāna
prācyavr̥ttiriyamucyatē vidhijñaiḥ

udīcyavr̥ttīyalakṣaṇaṁ cē
daupacchandasikē yathāsvamittham ।
tadōcyatē’sau kalāpravīṇai
raupacchandasikādyudīcyavr̥ttiḥ

pravartakīyaṁ yathāsvamaupa
cchandasē’tra yadabhāṇi lakṣaṇaṁ tat ।
pravartayatyaṁśamētadaupa
cchandasaprajanitaṁ pravartakākhyam

sundaraṁ sayatilakṣaṇaṁ yadaupa
cchandasaprakaṭitāparāntikōktam ।
chandasīha jayakīrtināmni caupa
cchandasaprajanitāparāntikā syāt

upāgataṁ cāruhāsinībhā
gupētyupacchandasīha taccēt⟨?⟩ ।
vipañcyatē cārulakṣaṇaṁ tat ।
prapañcataścāruhāsinīyam

āpātalikāhvayajātau ।
prācyavr̥ttigaditiryadi yasyām ।
sāpi tadāpātalikākhya
prācyavr̥ttirabhavadgavr̥ttyā⟨?⟩

udīcyavr̥ttērniyamō’sau ।
yadi tu bhavatyāpātalikāyām ।
udīcyavr̥ttistviti nāmnā ।
gaditāpātalikādirabhijñaiḥ

udīritāpātalikāyāṁ ।
yatpravartakamataṁ paridr̥ṣṭam ॥
yadā tadāpātalikādiḥ ।
syātpravartakamihārdhasamābham

āparāntikamidaṁ khalu lakṣma ।
prāpitaṁ yadi tadā talikāyām ॥
sāparā tadabhidhā talikādiḥ ।
śrīpurāṇakavipuṁgavagītā

pracōditāpātalikāyāṁ ।
sa cēdvidhiścārvabhidhāyāḥ⟨?⟩ ।
suvinmatāpātalikādiḥ ।
sucāruhāsinyapi cēt

ayujōrlaghavō’ṣṭa daśa yujō
rlau jō vā guruṇā tadantayōḥ ।
rlagaṇē tu tadādilaghuyati
rna viṣamalaghutō’trēti māgadhī

tōyadhimātragaṇatritayād
gō yadi nātra jakāragaṇaḥ ।
sthāyitr̥tīyapadāhnayugē⟨?⟩ sati ।
sō’yamabhāṇi guṇōguṇibhiḥ

ṣaṭkalataścatuṣkalagaṇāḥ pañcaiva gurustarāstathā⟨?⟩ ।
jō rlagaṇō’thavā dvitīyē ṣaṣṭhē ca na cētaratra jaḥ ॥
rlē sati tatra kararasasthānē prathamalaghau tu yatirasau ।
syād dvipadīti ṣaṭkalagaṇē lna samō’tra parēṇa yujyatē

prāktanalakṣaṇadvipadikāniyamaḥ sakalaḥ sa vartatē’smin ।
vyaktamatō’dhikē sati gurau pratipādamitīdamabjanālam ॥
ṣaṣṭhagaṇāntalaghuvihīnā cētprathamadvipadikāsau ।
niṣṭhitaśēṣalakṣaṇayutā bhavatīti hi kāmalēkhā

ūhitōkttitō galāṁśasaptakaṁ nirantaraṁ ।
gō hi naidhanē nakārasaptakaṁ yadāthavā ॥
vyāhitaṁ tadubhayamiśrasaptakaṁ tadā tathō
tsāhamāhurutsavaṁ ca gōgrahādikē budhāḥ

mahōtsavō jakārataḥ sagōtsavāṁśaṣaṭkayē ।
* * * * *
jakāratō glayugmakaṁ nakāragaṇavikalpitaṁ ।
svakāri guruparaṁ yadā prakāśyatē tadā ramā

utsavāṁhripūrvakaṁ yadā ramāṁhrikōttaraṁ ramāṁhriyugalakōttaram ।
prōtsamānvaritatadaṁhrikōtsavāṁhrinaidhanaṁ ramāṁhririti ca naidhanam ॥
yatsumōdayajjanaṁ ramaikapādadalaparaṁ tathōtsavādi vā param ।
ta(+tsa)mīritaṁ layānugāmi yamakavattaraṁ vicitragati layōttaram

nagaṇayugalatō’tha raiḥ saptabhirdaṇḍakaścaṇḍavr̥ṣṭiprapātastathaikōttaram ।
praticaraṇavr̥ddhayō’rṇārṇavavyālajīmūtalīlākarōddāmaśaṅkhādayaḥ ॥
pracita iti nayugmatō yaistathānyairamiśrīkr̥taistatpramāṇairyadōtpadyatē ।
śaragirigatilōkalabvādikā⟨?⟩ścaṇḍavātānda⟨?⟩siṁhāhvayāstē’nvitāṁ
śōttarāḥ

caṇḍavr̥ṣṭyādikādau laghūktau niyāmō’tra⟨?⟩ yō varjayitvēti taṁ paṇḍitaiḥ
ścyarēphādibhi⟨?⟩rdaṇḍakāṁśaistathā kēvalairyē kr̥tāḥ ।
daṇḍakā vr̥ttaśabdādikā vr̥ttavattē hi pādōktalakṣmētarā daṇḍakā
yē tu tē gadyapūrvāśca mālādikāstē’thavānēkadhā ॥
yastathōtsavōktagaṇamayō gurūttaraḥ sa cōtsavābhidhānadaṇḍakō
mahārhadādidēvatāstavē smr̥taḥ ।
jagaṇētarābdhimātrāgaṇō’tra bhr̥śamayuji dhāmni bhavati jagaṇō’thavā
nlagaṇa ēṣa nidhanē guruśca tu hi citradaṇḍakaḥ

vaitālīyamataḥ samavaitālīyaṁ ca viṣamavaitālīyam ।
aupacchandasikāpātalikē ca tathā tridhā tridhā navadhēti

tattattripañcakaṁ prācyavr̥ttisaṁjñāpyudīcyavr̥ttiśca ।
sārdhaṁ pravarttakēnāparāntikā cāruhāsinīti jinamitāḥ

māgadhikā guṇajātirdvipadītrayamutsavadvitayamapi ca ramā ।
pañcalayōttaravidhayō’pi caṇḍavr̥ṣṭyādidaṇḍakā gaṇadhōktāḥ

div.head: saptamō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
vakṣyē’kṣaratripadyēlākṣarikāṣaṭpadīcatuṣpadikāḥ ।
chandō’vataṁsasaṁjñā madanavatīgītikādimapi karṇāṭē

raladhā ratimadanaśarā dvitricaturgādayō’bdhivasunr̥pasaṁkhyāḥ ।
prastārē pūrvagurōradhō laghū dvau parasya caikaikalaghuḥ

dvitricaturvarṇā gādyāstricatuḥpañcavarṇakā lādigaṇāḥ ।
kramaśō ralabēṣu bhavantyēkaikalaghurna vartatē’tra gaṇādau

aṅgajagaṇayugād bāṇagaṇē ।
saṅgatē pratipādamalpākṣaram ॥
śr̥ṅgārapiṇḍādikāvyēṣu tat ।
saṅgītaṁ karṇāṭakē prasiddham

yadi tu ratigaṇaḥ pādādau pādamadhyē ।
madanagaṇayugaṁ pādāntē bāṇagaṇam ॥
tadidamantarākṣaramakṣarajñā ( r. jñair ) gītaṁ ।
viditamārhatē karṇāṭēśvarakathādau

prathamē ratirēva manmathaḥ syāddvitīyē tr̥tīyē’- ।
pyatha caturthē bāṇagaṇastu pañcamasthāna ēva ॥
grathitaṁ lakṣaṇamiti yasya tanmadhyamākṣarākhyaṁ ।
prathitaṁ karṇāṭamālatīmādhavaprabhr̥tikāvyē

ratipatigaṇayugmādratitaḥ smarayugmaṁ ratirapi ( add ca punaḥ ) ।
pratipādaṁ vartatē yasmiṁstatsamānākṣaraṁ nāma ॥
śrutikāntamakṣaradakṣairādr̥tamasagākhyakavinā ।
pratipāditaṁ nanu karṇāṭakumārasaṁbhavakāvyē

ādau ratigaṇō madhyē’tra smaragaṇapañcakamantē tu bāṇagaṇaḥ ।
pādēṣviha ratirvā dvitīyē turyē ca sthānē tanmahākṣarākhyam ॥
pādādiprabhr̥tīti kēvalaṁ smaragaṇaṣaṭkayaṁ bāṇāntaṁ kēcidāhuḥ ।
pādē pādē’tra pratigaṇamapi yatirlakṣyatē sarvēṣāmakṣarāṇām

karakarābdhitryaṁśa---- ।
caraṇā digrasaratiḥ ॥
smaramayī lādigiriharāṁśā cānta---- ॥
viramaṇāccitrā tripadikā

sarvalakṣaṇamatra ।
pūrvavaddharadhāmni ॥
gurvādibāṇagaṇabhāg vicitrā syāt ॥
pūrvaṁ karṇāṭacchandōmatē

mātrābhirdvōṣaṣṭyā⟨?⟩ ।
citrā syādityēvam ॥
mātrā vardhantē kvacidasyā nyūnāstāḥ ॥
sūtraṁ pūrvōktaṁ kimamūbhiḥ

r̥tuhatagiripari--- ।
mitalaghuriyamatha ॥
yatiyutirakhilagururiha na bhavati ॥
yatipatigaditamata iti

sarvalaghurna cēt ।
sarvathā tripadikā ॥
sarvagurustu na bhavēd girīśayō---- ।
rgurvādilagaṇapratiṣēdhāt

tripadī tr̥tīyāṁhrā--- ।
vapamuñcatyēlēti ॥
supaṭhitā gēyavidanaiḥ¹

madanādyāḥ śaragaṇāntāḥ ।
yadi caraṇāścatvāraḥ ॥
gaditāścēccatuṣpadikā ।
viditāsau cūḍāmaṇau

kandarpagaṇatō ratigaṇacatuṣkaṁ cēt ।
chandasi jayakīrtērādivarāhākhyā ॥
chandō’vataṁsanāmēti catuṣpadikā ।
saṁdr̥ṣṭāsau kumārasaṁbhavādau

smaragaṇaḥ paritō’tra । śaragaṇaḥ puraṣaṣṭha---- ।
caraṇāntayōstadantē virāmaḥ ॥
karakarapuragaṇāḥ । dvirihatyāścaraṇāścēt ।
sphurati ṣaṭcaraṇavat ṣaṭpadikā²

smararatipūrvaṁ smararatimadhyaṁ smarayugagurunidhanam ।
caraṇacatuṣkaṁ sthirataracaturuttaraśatamātramidam ॥
karivasumātrāviramaṇayuk cēt sphurati tadākṣarikā ।
guruparajagaṇētaragatimātrādharagaṇabhāgathavā
div.note: pañca kāmā ratiścaikā kāmō’ntē caraṇatrayē । pratyēkaṁ tāsu cēdētāśchandasvatyō’khilā matāḥ ॥ 125 ॥ gaṇādērnyūnatādhikyādēlābhāsā imā matāḥ ॥ 126 ॥ ---saṁgītaratnākara ( Adyar Ed. 1944 ) IV·

div.ab:
prathamaka iha guruparakr̥tiparimitalabhr̥ditarē---- ।
pyatha pādā ratigaṇaparagatimadanagaṇāḥ syuḥ ॥
prathitapadāvalayastaiścēditi madanavatī ।
prathitayatiḥ praticaraṇaṁ dvāviṁśatimātrā

ragaṇō dvitīyē ṣaṣṭhē ca ।
lagaṇō dhagaṇō vānyatra pañcasvardhayōśca ॥
trigaṇō’yuk samapādō’bdhigaṇō ।
nigaditā gītikālaṁkārē prabhusēnīyaiḥ

ādirgurupūrvaścētpādō gurupūrvakāstathānyē jātau ।
pādō laghupūrvaścēdādiḥ śēṣāstathaiva bhāṣāviṣayē

kimētāvanti padyāni cēhānuktānyanēkadhā ।
santi ṣaṭpratyayē tāni dr̥śyantē sūcitāni ca

div.head: aṣṭamō’dhikāraḥ
div.ab:
gaṇānāṁ pratyayānāṁ ca mukhyaḥ prastāra ēva saḥ ।
tasmātprastārasūtraṁ taddhyēkaṁ sarvatra dr̥śyatē

gurōradhastāllaghumāditaḥ kṣipētparaṁ likhēdūrdhvasamaṁ punastathā ।
pāścātyakhaṇḍaṁ guruṇā prapūrayēdyāvatpadaṁ sarvalaghutvamāpyatē

vinyasya sarvagurvēkadvicatuṣkānsamārdhasamaviṣamāṁhrīn ।
prastārayētpr̥thakpr̥thagiti kramāt vr̥ttavidhirayaṁ prastāraḥ

ēkaikēnāntaritā prastāraprathamapaṅktiriha gurulaghunā ।
tattaddviguṇitagalataḥ kramāddvitīyādipaṅktayō’ntaritāḥ syuḥ

ardhasamaprastārē saṁdr̥śyantē samārdhasamavr̥ttāni ।
viṣamaprastārē’tra tu samārdhasamaviṣamavr̥ttarūpāṇyakhilam

jātīnāmapi caturaḥ pādānvinyasya saṁbhavatsarvagurūn ।
prastārayēditi prāggaṇasaṁbhavamapi laghuprayōgaṁ jñātvā

pr̥cchakavr̥ttamitāṅkaṁ dalayēllaghu samadalē likhēdguru viṣamē ।
saikatvācchandōmiti janayēditi naṣṭavr̥ttarūpakamaṅkāt

rūpitavr̥ttapratigalamēkādidviguṇitāḥ syurupari tadaṅkān ।
lagatānsaikānyuktvā tāvatithaṁ vr̥ttamiti vadētprastārē

chandōvarṇānēkādhikarūpānutkramānnidhāyā (+dhastā)t ।
tattaduparyupari tathā kṣipēditi punaḥ punarjahannēkaikam

ādyanta( r. ntē ) sarvalagē ēkādilaghūni madhyavr̥ttānyēṣu ।
piṇḍīkr̥tēṣu saṁkhyā saikōddiṣṭāṅkapiṇḍitā vā saṁkhyā

chandō’kṣarē samadalē śūnyaṁ nyasya viṣamē tathā rūpam ।
rūpē taddviguṇaṁ khē vargaḥ samavr̥ttasaṁkhyā syāt

jñātasamavr̥ttasaṁkhyā tattadguṇatō’rdhasamakasaṁkhyā mūlāt ।
tattadguṇātsamūlārdhasamamitērviṣamavr̥ttamitirapamūlā

pañcavidhavr̥ttasaṁkhyā sthānē svākṣarahatē dvitīyādidalē ।
dalitatr̥tīyacaturthē sārdhāntē vr̥ttavarṇagurulaghumātrā

jātyaṁhricatuṣkē pratigaṇaṁ kṣipēttatra saṁbhavadgaṇasaṁkhyām ।
guṇa (+yē) danyōnyaṁ tatsaṁkhyā syātsarvajātisaṁkhyēti matā

āryātha saptapañcāśanmātrā skandhakaścatuḥṣaṣṭikalaḥ ।
tadvanmātrāsamakaṁ sadvādaśaśatakalā dvipadikētyādēḥ

jātērmātrāpiṇḍē svākṣararahitē kr̥tē sthitā guravaḥ syuḥ ।
gururahitē’kṣarasaṁkhyā laghurahitē’rdhīkr̥tē tu gurusaṁkhyā syāt

chandaḥsaṁkhyā hatā dvābhyāmēkarūpavivarjitā ।
chinnavr̥ttāṅgulavyāptiradhvayōgō bhavēditi

prastārō naṣṭamuddiṣṭamēkadvyādilaghukriyā ।
saṁkhyānamadhvayōgaścētyuktaṁ pratyayaṣaṭkayam

māṇḍavyapiṅgalajanāśrayasaitavākhya
śrīpādapūjyajayadēvabudhādikānām ।
chandāṁsi vīkṣya vividhānapi satprayōgān
chandō’nuśāsanamidaṁ jayakīrtinōktam
